written.headline: Democrats plan tighter oversight of Nvidia on chip exports and financing
written.summary: Democrats, with Elizabeth Warren a leading candidate to chair the Senate Banking Committee, are preparing to increase oversight of Nvidia. The focus will be on the company's chip export practices and its circular financing arrangements.

written.headline: Wall Street banks pitch pieces of SpaceX’s $40 billion AI chip financing
written.summary: Goldman Sachs and Apollo Global Management are seeking investors to buy stakes up to $500 million in a roughly $40 billion off‑balance‑sheet financing that will lease Nvidia GPUs to SpaceX. The deal is expected to close before the end of 2026, with hardware delivery slated for the first half of 2027.

written.headline: Nvidia requires Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in chip‑tracking program
written.summary: Nvidia is making Southeast Asian customers who want Nvidia Cloud Partner status join a program that records the locations of their AI chips. The move is intended to curb semiconductor smuggling, especially to China.
